title.zh: 软银寻求筹集至多1000亿美元，用于加码大规模人工智能投资
title.en: 软银寻求筹集至多1000亿美元，用于加码大规模人工智能投资

current_state.zh: SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son is reportedly in talks with Gulf investors, including UAE contacts, to raise as much as $100 billion for a fund aimed at expanding the firm's large-scale AI investments and acquiring companies to overhaul with AI.
